articles.title: Chocolate in Georgia? Ancient Pots Say Yes — 1,000 Years Ago!
articles.summary: Scientists found tiny traces of cacao — the plant that makes chocolate — on 1,000-year-old pottery in Georgia. That's the earliest proof of chocolate east of the Mississippi River!

articles.title: Sharks Can Hear You From 243 Feet Away — And They Know Where You Are
articles.summary: Scientists played underwater sounds near wild blacktip sharks. The sharks heard them from up to 243 feet away — and turned away fast. That's like hearing a whisper across a whole soccer field!

articles.title: Jupiter: The Giant Planet That's Like a Whole Solar System
articles.summary: Jupiter is so big that more than 1,300 Earths could fit inside it! It has a hurricane that's been spinning for centuries and nearly 70 moons. One moon, Europa, might even hide alien life under its ice.
